title: Hand-Operated Chain Sharpener – Sharpening Tool for Chainsaws
descriptionHtml:
A sharp chain makes all the difference

A dull saw chain wears on both the chainsaw and your arms. Cutting goes sluggishly and the result is unpredictable.

Sharpen the chain anywhere

With this hand-operated chain sharpener you sharpen the chain quickly without electricity. It's small and easy to bring out to the woods or to the cabin.

Features

  • Sharpens the saw chain quickly and evenly
  • Hand-operated – no electricity needed
  • Small and easy to take along
  • Fits most chainsaw chains
  • Makes cutting easier and safer

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
